parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ay ON a.assay_id = ay.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ay.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ay.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
